Legacy identity encodings stay untouched; new components add named sections. Expose re-assessment over HTTP; auto re-verify when only the build fingerprint differs.
Done when: the compatibility corpus passes unchanged and a dataset accepted under an older build can be corrected under a newer one.

Source: docs/build-plan.md, section 8, package 3.
